changelog:
amazon-alexa-qa 1.0.0

- Initial release for automating Shopping Q&A using Amazon's Alexa/Rufus AI shopping assistant.
- Submits questions and collects structured Alexa response text, supporting both general and category-specific queries.
- Optional keyword-based context: can navigate to product search results before Q&A to improve category relevance.
- Includes pre-execution checks for browser tool readiness and Amazon login status.
- Provides error handling and batch automation examples for streamlined Q&A collection.
